title: Flat extension to a field preserves bounded finite cohomology
statement: For commutative R, field S and a flat ring map f:R to S, a complex of R-modules whose derived cohomology has finite support and is finitely generated in every degree has termwise f-scalar extension with bounded finite-dimensional S-cohomology.

source.place: the assertion that evaluation at the geometric point lands in $D^b_{\mathrm{fin}}$, $D^b_{\mathrm{fg}}$, $D^b_{\mathrm{fd}}$

proof.text: Flat scalar extension preserves finite limits, and its left adjoint property preserves finite colimits. Additivity and exactness give (C.sc i).mapHomologyIso; compose with homologyFunctorFactors on both sides. Map zero objects to retain the finite support. Tensor base change of a finite module is finite over S by Module.Finite.base_change, and transport this property through the homology linear equivalence. Over a field this is finite dimensionality.

proof_origin.place: Point evaluation, finite/integral/rational landing assertions; original six-step proof, specialized as recorded

theorem pointFiniteDimensional_of_flat_scalar_extension
    {R S : Type u} [CommRing R] [Field S] (f : R →+* S) (hf : f.Flat)
    (C : CochainComplex (ModuleCat.{u} R) ℤ)
    (hs : ∃ s : Finset ℤ, ∀ i : ℤ, i ∉ s →
      IsZero ((homologyFunctor (ModuleCat.{u} R) i).obj (Q.obj C)))
    (hfinite : ∀ i : ℤ,
      Module.Finite R ((homologyFunctor (ModuleCat.{u} R) i).obj (Q.obj C))) :
    pointFiniteDimensional S
      (Q.obj (((ModuleCat.extendScalars f).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj C))
